Do NOT clone Wing's square jaw or triangular nose onto everybody; retain this subject's different face outline in simplified cartoon form. Centered waist-up, one adult, two connected arms and exactly two hands; full head/shoulders/hands/props safely inside frame with consistent small transparent padding. Match the scale and line thickness of the reference cast. Genuinely transparent background, no background shape, no text/lettering/logos/watermarks. SUBJECT: The subject is Sonny: short tousled black fringe, thick BLACK RECTANGULAR glasses, friendly rounded face, TAN plain T-shirt. Keep a TURQUOISE noodle cup in one hand and chopsticks in the other. Simplify the noodles and smile into bold readable cartoon shapes. No printer, no extra arm.
